description: Convert every payment to US dollars and add them up, in cents. A USD payment is already in dollars. For any other currency X, use the rate for X from the rates for base `USD`, which gives units of X per 1 USD: the payment's `cents` divided by that rate, rounded to the nearest whole cent, is its value in US cents. A payment in a currency with no rate is left out of the total. Return a record with `total`: the sum of the converted amounts in cents, and `unconverted`: the ids of payments left out, ascending.

types.Payment: Record {id: String, cents: Int, currency: String}

capabilities.description: Lists payments with their amount in minor units of their currency.
Returns, for each currency code, how many units of it equal one unit of the base currency.
